label: Profet-arkitektur: net10 + födelsestatusspecifik demografi
purpose: Test a genuinely new Profet-inspired architecture that preserves the validated net10 migration baseline and validated birth-status allocation while adding national Swedish-born/foreign-born fertility and mortality differentials from the same SCB forecast vintage.

migration.totalConstraint: exact production net10 by sex and one-year age
migration.allocation: locked historical gross-flow shares from birth_status_net10_candidate

fertility.localBase: existing localized production fertility rate by maternal age
fertility.statusAdjustment: multiply local aggregate fertility by same-vintage national birth-status fertility relative to same-vintage aggregate national fertility

mortality.localBase: existing localized production mortality risk by sex and age
mortality.statusAdjustment: convert local risk to hazard, multiply by same-vintage national birth-status hazard relative to same-vintage aggregate national hazard, then convert back to probability

structuralRequirements: net migration must remain identical to birth_status_net10_constrained
status population accounting must sum to total population
evaluation.governance: 2018-2024 is development evidence only. No status multiplier, normalization or window may be changed after results. Level 3 requires a separately locked external or future holdout.
